info.title: POSAI API
info.description: POSAI – Restaurant POS SaaS Backend API

bearerAuth.description: JWT Bearer token for API authentication

get.description: Returns server uptime and database connection state

post.description: Creates the single restaurant profile for the tenant. OWNER only. Returns 409 if a restaurant already exists.

409.description: Restaurant already exists for this tenant

get.description: Retrieves the restaurant profile for the active tenant. Accessible by any authenticated role. Returns 404 when none exists.

404.description: Restaurant not found for this tenant

patch.description: Updates restaurant profile fields. OWNER and ADMIN roles only. Empty body returns 400.

403.description: Forbidden - OWNER or ADMIN role required

404.description: Restaurant not found for this tenant

post.description: Creates a new branch for the tenant. OWNER and ADMIN only. Requires an existing restaurant. First branch is automatically assigned isMain=true.

400.description: Validation failed or forbidden fields (isMain, etc.)

403.description: Forbidden - OWNER or ADMIN role required

409.description: Restaurant required or duplicate branch code

get.description: Retrieves branches for the active tenant. OWNER and ADMIN see all branches; other roles see only assigned branches.
Retrieves a branch by ID. Returns 404 if the branch does not exist, belongs to another tenant, or the user lacks access.

patch.description: Updates editable branch fields. OWNER and ADMIN only. Cannot deactivate main branch (409 CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_MAIN_BRANCH).

400.description: Validation failed, invalid ID, or unmodifiable fields

403.description: Forbidden - OWNER or ADMIN role required

get.summary: Get current user and onboarding context
get.description: Retrieves user profile, tenant info, restaurant profile, and accessible branches. Exempt from mustChangePassword gate. Accessible by all authenticated roles.

200.description: User profile and onboarding context retrieved successfully

post.description: Creates a new tenant and initial OWNER user account. Fails with 409 if email is already registered.

201.description: Tenant and OWNER account created successfully

400.description: Validation failed or disallowed fields present

post.description: Authenticates user with email and password, issuing an access token and HttpOnly refresh cookie.

403.description: Account disabled, email unverified, or tenant suspended

post.description: Revokes active refresh token family and clears HttpOnly refresh cookie. Idempotent.
Rotates refresh token atomically, issues a new access token, and sets a new HttpOnly refresh cookie.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Allows authenticated user to change password. Invalidates all active refresh token families across all devices.

400.description: Invalid current password or validation failure

post.description: Atomically verifies user email address using single-use verification token.

400.description: Invalid, used, or expired verification token

post.description: Sends a new email verification link if the account exists and is unverified. 60-second cooldown per user.

200.description: Generic success message regardless of account existence

post.description: Sends password reset link if account exists and is ACTIVE. 60-second cooldown per user.

200.description: Generic success message regardless of account existence

post.description: Resets password using single-use reset token, updates email verification status, and invalidates all active sessions.

400.description: Invalid, used, or expired reset token, or validation error
